checks.note: developer.gladly.com/rest/ states Basic auth with agent email + API token over HTTPS. OAuth is not mentioned. The 'unscoped token' quote was not visible in the fetched text, but the Basic-only claim holds.

Token steps (API User permission, More settings > API Tokens) are confirmed. The pricing page shows no trial or self-serve signup, only Get a Demo and Contact sales. 'partner_gated' is the wrong category, since no partner program is cited. This is a sales-led paid customer tenant, so 'paid_plan' fits. Whether API access depends on plan tier is not stated.
REST with about 21 tag groups (Agents, Conversations, Customers, Tasks, Reports, Webhooks, Topics, Events, Export and others), which fits 'broad'.

No vendor page was found announcing or denying an official MCP server. Search found only third-party hosted options (StackOne, Truto). A third-party report says Gladly publishes none. 'none_found' is the best-supported value, but the cited Truto page does not settle it. I changed the evidence URL to the StackOne page.

With a documented, broad REST API and a paid tenant requirement, the verdict follows from the other fields as 'ready_with_caveats', not 'blocked'. The caveats are that a developer needs a sales-led tenant, the token is unscoped, and rate-limit values are unknown.

corrected.one_liner: Gladly is a customer service platform that manages customer conversations across channels around a unified customer profile, with AI assistance for support teams.
corrected.auth_notes: HTTP Basic Auth: username is the agent's email, password is an API token, sent over HTTPS (e.g. curl -u user@org.com:$GLADLY_API_TOKEN https://org.gladly.com/api/v1/organization). The token is tied to an agent profile. Public Answers endpoints need no token. No OAuth is documented for third-party API access. The claim that the token is unscoped was not visible in the fetched text.
corrected.access_notes: A token requires a Gladly tenant (org.gladly.com). An admin gives an agent the "API User" permission, then that agent creates a token under More settings > API Tokens. The pricing page shows no free trial, self-serve signup or prices, only "Get a Demo" and "Contact sales". The path is a sales-led Gladly customer account. No free developer sandbox was found, and whether API access depends on plan tier is not stated.
corrected.blocker: No self-serve signup, free tier or trial, so credentials need an existing paying Gladly tenant obtained through sales. Once a tenant exists, the API is documented and usable. Tokens are static and appear unscoped, and rate limits exist but their values were not found.
